description: This file defines the EmployeeAddress class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent an employee's address details including street, city, province, zipcode, and country. It includes methods for constructing address instances and converting them to string representations, with logic to fetch country names from a repository.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Data transfer object representing an employee's address, capable of converting itself to a string with formatted address details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of EmployeeAddress with address components such as street, city, province, zipcode, and country.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the address, including country name retrieved via repository if country code is provided.
